name: Shrine Descent
description: Descend into the dark shrine. Ancient evil stirs in the depths, and the shadows watch your every step.

dialog.speaker: Wounded Hunter
dialog.text: Don't go deeper. I barely made it out. The things in there... they're not like the creatures on the surface.

dialog.speaker: Wounded Hunter
dialog.text: It's like the air itself is wrong. My head's been pounding since I set foot in this place.
